Definition: from G3844 and G2572; to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively):--hide.
BiblicalUsage: Parakalyptō means to cover over, to veil, to hide. The disciples do not understand Jesus' saying about being delivered into the hands of men, and it is hid from them, that they perceive it not, and they are afraid to ask Him of that saying.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that some hiding is mercy: the disciples cannot yet bear the cross, so the saying is veiled until the time comes when they can.
